_skip_notes.^https://console\\.cloud\\.google\\.com: requires authentication — 401 responses are expected. Mirrors the same entry in mdk-docs excluded-url-prefixes.json; the two repos have separate link-check configs, so a URL allowlisted there is still checked here.
_skip_notes.^https?://(localhost|127\\.0\\.0\\.1)(:(: example URLs for a stack the crawler is not running (Gateway, dashboard, agent, mock devices), port-scoped so linkinator's own file server on a random high port is still crawled. Nothing listens on these, so every attempt is refused; linkinator tolerates that, but a Socket Firewall wrapper prints an unexpected-error notice per attempt. Never widen this to a bare localhost match: that skips the crawl roots and the sweep checks nothing.
_skip_notes.^https://qvac\\.tether\\.io: false positive: live host (HTTP 200) but a Cloudflare/Next.js dynamic page whose cold-cache render can exceed the 30s timeout, so linkinator reports status 0 (timeout, not a dead link). Skipping avoids intermittent CI flakes.

_statusCodes_notes.401: auth-walled but real: the server answered, so the link is not broken. Google Cloud Console credentials pages 401 the unauthenticated CI crawler.
_statusCodes_notes.403: same as 401 — exists, but the crawler may not read it.
_statusCodes_notes.429: rate limiting is a property of the crawl, not of the link.

_see_also: docs/scripts/sfw-env.sh holds the outbound allowlist your shell's Socket Firewall (sfw) needs so these checks can actually reach the hosts above — a different concern from this skip list (this file says what to never check; that one says what to let through). See docs/reference/maintainers/linters.md for why they're kept as separate files. Directory-shaped `skip` entries (any entry whose `_skip_notes` value contains "bare directory path") are verified against the filesystem by docs/scripts/check-directory-links.mjs, run as part of `npm run link-check`. Add a matching `_skip_notes` entry for every new directory skip — an entry without one makes that check throw and fail CI hard, by design.
